kb.tpl.onboarding.welcome.body:
Glad to have you with us! Here is everything a new employee needs in the first weeks.

## Where to start

1. Read the subpages «First day» and «First week».
2. Get to know the company and the tools.
3. If anything is unclear, ask your mentor.

> Add to this page: who the mentor is, where you sit, how to reach HR.

kb.tpl.rules.desc: Working hours, vacations, business trips, security, documents
kb.tpl.rules.about.title: Rules
kb.tpl.rules.about.body:
The rules every employee follows.

## How to use

- Each rule has an owner who changes it.
- The history of changes is kept: you can always see what changed and when.
- If a rule is out of date, write to its owner.
kb.tpl.rules.worktime.title: Working hours
kb.tpl.rules.worktime.body:
## Schedule

The working day is from 9:00 to 18:00, lunch is 1 hour.

## Check-in

The start and the end of the day are marked in go24 («Working day»).

## Being late and overtime

Tell your manager in advance if you are late.
kb.tpl.rules.vacation.title: Vacations and absences
kb.tpl.rules.vacation.body:
## How to take a vacation

1. Agree on the dates with your manager at least two weeks ahead.
2. Mark the vacation in the absence chart of go24.
3. Hand over your work and name a deputy.

## Sick leave

Tell your manager on the first day and mark the absence.
kb.tpl.rules.trips.title: Business trips
kb.tpl.rules.trips.body:
## How it goes

1. A trip request is a task for your manager.
2. The office manager books tickets and the hotel.
3. After the trip, an expense report within three working days.

## Per diem

The per diem is set by the company's order.
kb.tpl.rules.security.title: Information security
kb.tpl.rules.security.body:
## The main rules

- Never share passwords, not even with colleagues.
- Lock your computer when you leave it.
- Do not open attachments from unknown senders.
- Keep work files on the company Drive, not on personal devices.

## If something happened

Tell IT right away.
kb.tpl.rules.docs.title: Documents
kb.tpl.rules.docs.body:
## How documents are approved

1. The author prepares the document on Drive.
2. Approval goes as a workflow or a task.
3. The signed document is kept in the shared folder.

## Document templates

Ready templates of contracts and letters are in «Documents».

kb.tpl.faq.access.title: Access and accounts
kb.tpl.faq.access.body:
## I forgot my password — what to do?

Use «Forgot password?» on the sign-in page or write to IT.

## How do I get access to a folder on Drive?

Ask the owner of the folder to open it to you («Access rights»).

## How do I connect my mail?

In «Mail» — «Connect a mailbox».
kb.tpl.faq.money.title: Salary and payments
kb.tpl.faq.money.body:
## When is the salary paid?

Twice a month: an advance and the main part.

## Where do I get a pay slip?

Ask the accounting department.

## How do I get expenses refunded?

Attach the receipts to a task for accounting.
kb.tpl.faq.it.title: Hardware and software
kb.tpl.faq.it.body:
## My computer broke

Set a task for IT and describe what happened.

## I need a program

Agree with your manager and set a task for IT — do not install programs yourself.

apps.howto: OAuth 2.0: the application sends the employee to %[1]s/oauth/authorize?client_id=<code> (they come back to redirect_uri on the handler's domain with a code), exchanges the code for tokens — %[1]s/oauth/token?grant_type=authorization_code&client_id=…&client_secret=…&code=…, refreshes — grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=…. The access token lives an hour, the refresh token 28 days. REST API: %[1]s/api/v1/… with the header Authorization: Bearer <access_token> — with the application's permissions and the employee's rights. go24 events come signed with X-Go24-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 with the application key) and application_token in auth.
apps.howto_places: Placements, as placement.*: an application with the «placement» right binds a handler to a place with an administrator's token — POST %[1]s/api/v1/placements {"placement": "CRM_DEAL_DETAIL_TAB", "handler": "https://…", "title": "…"} (the handler on the application's host), unbinds — DELETE with placement and handler, its bindings — GET %[1]s/api/v1/placements, the places — GET …/placements/list: CRM_LEAD_DETAIL_TAB, CRM_DEAL_DETAIL_TAB, CRM_CONTACT_DETAIL_TAB, CRM_COMPANY_DETAIL_TAB, CRM_DYNAMIC_<type>_DETAIL_TAB, TASK_VIEW_TAB. The tab opens the handler in a frame of the card with the employee's tokens, PLACEMENT and PLACEMENT_OPTIONS — {"ID": …} of a CRM card, {"taskId": key} of a task.
apps.howto_events: Events, as event.*: an application subscribes a handler to an event with an administrator's token — POST %[1]s/api/v1/events {"event": "ONCRMDEALADD", "handler": "https://…"} (the handler on the application's host; "auth_type" — the ID of the employee whose tokens come in the event, by default the one who subscribes), unsubscribes — DELETE with event and handler, its subscriptions — GET %[1]s/api/v1/events, the events — GET …/events/list: ONCRMLEADADD/UPDATE/DELETE, ONCRMDEALADD/…, ONCRMCONTACTADD/…, ONCRMCOMPANYADD/…, ONCRMDYNAMICITEMADD/… (smart processes, ENTITY_TYPE_ID), ONTASKADD/UPDATE/DELETE, ONUSERADD, ONAPPUNINSTALL. The handler gets POST JSON {"event", "event_handler_id", "data": {"FIELDS": {"ID": …}}, "ts", "auth"} signed with X-Go24-Signature (HMAC-SHA256 with the application's key) and auth.application_token; on failure it is retried in 1, 5, 30 minutes, 2 and 6 hours.
apps.howto_sdk: An application's page in the frame includes go24.js, as BX24.js: <script src="%[1]s/go24.js"></script>, then go24.init(). Then go24.getAuth() and refreshAuth() (the employee's tokens), go24.callMethod("GET", "crm/deals", {…}) (REST with the application's rights), go24.placement.info() (the place and PLACEMENT_OPTIONS), resizeWindow(), fitWindow(), setTitle(), openPath("/crm/deals"), reloadWindow(), closeApplication(), selectUser() and selectUsers() (choosing employees), appOption.get/set and userOption.get/set (the application's and the employee's settings; REST — /api/v1/app/options and /api/v1/app/user-options), getLang(), isAdmin(). Every call returns a Promise.
